title: Molecular Mechanisms for Bacterial Potassium Homeostasis.
scope: Narrative review read in full. Use comparative architecture, not E. coli kinetic values as universal species measurements; predates the tandem-kinase result.

title: The KdpFABC complex - K(+) transport against all odds.
scope: Narrative review read in full; older alternative transport models are reconciled with 2025/2026 primary structure-function studies.
manual_classification_basis: The full article is a narrative review of KdpFABC structure/function, as noted in scope; retain the cached machine classification separately without editing the immutable source.

title: The Kdp-ATPase system and its regulation.
scope: Review abstract accessed. Historical cyanobacterial and Deinococcus examples motivate regulatory diversity; no unaccessed full-text experiment is claimed.

title: The roles and regulation of potassium in bacteria.
scope: Review abstract accessed. Retain the comparative systems principle; historical claims that only Kdp transcription is environmentally regulated are not adopted as current universal rules.

title: The KdpF subunit is part of the K(+)-translocating Kdp complex of Escherichia coli and is responsible for stabilization of the complex in vitro.
scope: Primary deletion/reconstitution abstract accessed. Optionality is conditioned on the E. coli experiment; it does not establish KdpF dispensability for every organism or detergent assay.

title: Purification, reconstitution, and characterization of KdpD, the turgor sensor of Escherichia coli.
scope: Primary abstract accessed. Purified reconstitution supports canonical cognate relay chemistry; no universal turgor-sensing mechanism is inferred from the historical title.

title: Structure-function studies of DNA binding domain of response regulator KdpE reveals equal affinity interactions at DNA half-sites.
scope: Primary full text read. Preserve the distinction between receiver signaling, promoter recognition and full-length transcriptional output; DNA binding alone is not sufficient evidence for output.

title: KdpD is a tandem serine histidine kinase that controls K(+) pump KdpFABC transcriptionally and post-translationally.
scope: Primary full text read. Dgeo protein assays used E. coli pump substrates; this is direct regulatory biochemistry, not complete native Dgeo pump characterization. Do not transfer ASK activity to all KdpD members.

title: Regulation of potassium uptake in Caulobacter crescentus.
scope: Primary full text read, matched NA1000 panel. KdpD phosphatase mechanism is inferred from genetics/reporters and phase dependence; no alternative kinase identity or purified phosphotransfer is claimed.

title: Binding of Cyclic Di-AMP to the Staphylococcus aureus Sensor Kinase KdpD Occurs via the Universal Stress Protein Domain and Downregulates the Expression of the Kdp Potassium Transporter.
scope: Primary full text read. Cellular experiments use LAC* and the second protein is from MRSA252; NCTC8325 representation uses the documented sequence/orthology bridge, not relabeled assays.

title: Conduction pathway for potassium through the Escherichia coli pump KdpFABC.
scope: Final published primary study read; use instead of older preprint as the current route evidence. No native rate or flux is transferred to other species.

title: On the mechanism of K+ transport through the inter-subunit tunnel of KdpFABC.
scope: Primary full text read. Simulations, anomalous scattering and functional assays refine microscopic coupling, without proving every proposed intermediate of the transport cycle.

title: Crystal structure of the potassium-importing KdpFABC membrane complex.
scope: Primary structural evidence used for complex architecture; newer work refines the ion path. Not a direct structure of every representative.

title: Structural basis for potassium transport in prokaryotes by KdpFABC.
scope: Primary full text read. State structures support assembled-complex mechanism, not autonomous transport by either isolated A or B.
